note: Former KOA on the Great River Road at the north edge of Quincy, in woods at the foot of the bluff, with mostly concrete pads, a pool and a playground. More than half the sites are rented by the month. The operator warns against routing via Cedar Street, which passes under a low, narrow rail bridge; rigs over 15 years old must call before booking. --Claude
summary: Operator site read: $45 back-in / $50 pull-through FHU + $3 reservation fee, monthly $22/night, open year-round, WiFi/laundry/showers/pool, 3-night Memorial/Labor Day minimum.
